results.title: Migration
results.overview: After a migrating duck family alights on their pond with thrilling tales of far-flung places, the Mallard family embarks on a family road trip, from New England, to New York City, to tropical Jamaica.

results.title: Migration
results.overview: Red Bird migrates to warmer lands.

results.title: The Quiet Migration
results.overview: Carl is expected someday to take over his parents’ agribusiness in a rural backwater in Denmark. But, as an adopted child, he also longs to learn more about his South Korean heritage. A film about otherness and finding your own place in life.

results.title: Self-Fiction, Self-Migration
results.overview: The director/researcher speaks about her migration, and her complex relationship with her field of studies in Rajasthan. This movie is built on the basis of a musical collaboration between the researcher and Salim Khan, a musician.

results.title: Forced Migration of Butterflies
results.overview: Butterflies die if you move them elsewhere. But artists without a living can’t stay together in their commune in Tbilisi forever.

results.title: Zombieland: Migration, drugs, and violence made German cities unbearable
results.original_title: Zombieland - Drogen, Gewalt und Migration in Deutschlands Städten
results.overview: People who have emigrated to Germany struggle to cope. Homeless people tell how they ended up on the streets and what preoccupies them.

results.title: Epic Animal Migrations: Patagonia
results.overview: For thousands of animals every year, migrating across Patagonia is the only chance of survival as they return to give birth and raise their young or come home to feed.
